Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to efficiently gather shipping rate information for the requested carriers (FedEx, DHL, and USPS). The initial search for FedEx rates was misdirected to general pages and did not lead to retrieving concrete shipping rates. This inefficiency cascaded into repeated attempts without productive outcomes, causing delays and ultimately failing to provide the correct solution.
